role: CLI that downloads named PhysioNet files from the open-data S3 mirror with retries and short-read / S3-XML-error detection.
toplevel: Calls main() when run as a script (line 59).

units.does: Downloads https://physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com/<db>/<ver>/<name> to <outdir>/<name> via a .part file, up to 40 attempts with sleep min(2+i,15) s between; returns the destination path, or raises RuntimeError with the last error.

branches.effect: returns the existing file without any validation. The script itself never leaves a truncated dest (it writes <name>.part and os.replace()s only after the Content-Length / S3-XML checks, lines 27-42), but a non-empty file placed there by anything else, or one downloaded when the server sent no Content-Length, is trusted as-is
streams 1 MiB chunks to the .part file

branches.cond: Content-Length present and file size differs
file starts with '<?xml' and contains '<Error>' in first 400 bytes
branches.effect: raises IOError (S3 error body) -> retry; else renames .part to dest and returns
records it, sleeps, retries; after all tries raises RuntimeError

units.does: CLI entry: argv = db, version, outdir, then file names; fetches each name and prints path and size.

branches.effect: fetch and print; no names => no-op
